programs.title: Mammals - Making Of
programs.desc: Behind the scenes of the production of a nature production presenting the life of mammals.The most diverse phylum of the animal kingdom includes both the tiny Etruscan shrew and the blue whale.

programs.title: Life Below Zero: Canada
programs.desc: The program shows the everyday life of people in Canada and their struggles with the forces of nature.

programs.title: Wild London
programs.desc: A famous naturalist reveals the nature present in the landscape of his native London.It presents extraordinary stories taking place in the center of the metropolis, including:peregrine falcons nesting on the parliament building.

programs.title: Life Below Zero
programs.desc: Alaska has extremely harsh climatic conditions.Temperatures there regularly drop to life-threatening levels.Despite this, the region is inhabited by people.The tenth season of the program presents the everyday adventures of the inhabitants of four households from different parts of the Alaskan wilderness.Their lives focus primarily on hunting and careful preparations for and struggles with the long and frosty winter.Viewers will see, among others:Agnes Hailstone, who with her daughters tries to hunt caribou while her husband is away.
